predictions: Oh, man, last week was just a hot mess for me here. B, C and F divisions just beat me up, and I limped to a pretty sad 13-10 record for the week. I was a super pathetic 3-8 in those three divisions, and I (of course) got both tiebreaker matches wrong again. That brings me to 42-25 for the season (for a correct pick rate of only 62.7%) so far. B and F divisions have just abused me to this point - good thing Dart Side is there, so I at least have a chance, as I seem to always get their match picks right.

Match of the week: (E Div.) Bad Mutha Duckas @ Hump Day! This week's battle of undefeateds resides in E division, and it will leave this division with a sole unblemished leader at the end of the night. These were my two preseason picks in E, and they certainly haven't let me down so far. Both teams are averaging 16+ so far and have real title aspirations, but I have to stick with my preseason Ducks pick, 14-10.

Match #2: (F Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Village Idiots. Dart Side is the only remaining undefeated F team, but the Idiots are only a match back and are tied for the F point lead. While I saw Dart Side headed to E in my preseason expectations, I have a feeling about the Idiots here. I think F will soon have no undefeated teams left. Village Idiots, 13-11.

Match #3: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Why So Serious? Five of the eight B teams already have two losses, so this pairing of 2-1 teams is a super contender battle. Somehow, Dart Attack continues to win matches despite the inability to take nearly any DCkt games. Over a season in, and that still doesn't seem like a long-term success plan. Serious, 13-11.

Matches #4 & #5: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Double In Stumble Out; Nine Lives @ Show Me Your Tips. Three weeks into the season, C is a glorious mess of non-clarity. Every team already has a loss, and the winless team has only played twice. There are FIVE one-loss teams staking a claim to the C lead right now, and four of those five pair up in these two matches tonight, so the stakes are high. McGavin and Stumble Out have been about as even as possible so far, but I'm just feeling the Stumblers a bit, 13-11. And while it has never been a lucrative proposition to pick against the Niners very often, I think Show Me really wants to bounce back from their painful 301 sweep last week; they win here, 14-10.

Match #6: (D Div.) BullsHit @ DD-214. Constantly and the Bandits have yet to lose, so winning this matchup between 2-1 teams is a pretty important step to stay close in the D race. DD has really shown well so far, but I think I'm hopping in on BullsHit here, 14-10.

Match #7: (G Div.) Runs with Corks @ Punk in Drublic. The Corks are undefeated and fighting for the G lead, but the 1-2 Punk actually has only lost once at the line so far (and had a really strong match against Rippin last week). I'll take the Corks, but it'll be tight, 13-11.

Matches #8 & #9: (B Div.) Double In, Uber Out @ Dysfunctional Outlaws; Iceman's Ear Defenders @ Boom Baby. Over in match #3, I explained that there is a brick of 1-2 teams chasing the top three in B. And every single one of those 1-2 teams is averaging 10+ so far, so there is a crapload of fighting left to be done in this free-for-all. And a lot of that starts right here, where two of these teams will get back to 0.500 and be right in the thick of the race. The Outlaws will ease past Uber Out, 14-10; and Iceman will take a 1001 over Boom.
Match #10: (F Div.) Shoot-Da-Bull @ Bangin the Wire. Shoot finally hit the win column last week, while Bangin lost a 2nd straight, and now these 1-2 squads are trying to stay alive. Bangin? 13-11.

Match #11: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Y.N.T.A. With the E leaders squaring off tonight, the winner here could be fighting for 2nd soon. Y.N.T.A. is the 2-loss team so far, but soon they both will be. 14-10.
Match #12: (F Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Shark Shooters. Since their 501 collapse in week 1, Ton 80 has been exerting its will and sending a message. I think that message continues being sent here, 16-8.
